description: This file defines the SugarFieldBool class, a subclass of SugarFieldBase, responsible for handling boolean fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for rendering search views, sanitizing imported data, providing email template values, and unformatting fields.

classes.name: SugarFieldBool
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase to implement boolean field specific behaviors such as rendering search views, sanitizing input, and handling email display for boolean fields.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the HTML content for the search view, rendering different templates based on the field name pattern.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input values for import, converting common boolean-like strings and values into proper boolean representations.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Provides the string representation of the boolean value for email templates based on global language strings.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts a formatted field string into a boolean value.
